summary: The note describes the vice presidency of Sierra Leone, presented as the second most influential post in the government after the president. It identifies the current vice president as Mohamed Juldeh Jalloh, a member of the ruling Sierra Leone People's Party, who was sworn in on April 4, 2018 after the 2018 presidential election victory of his ticket.
one_line: Overview of the vice-presidency of Sierra Leone, its standing in government, and current vice president Mohamed Juldeh Jalloh.
key_facts: The vice president of Sierra Leone is the second most influential position in the government of Sierra Leone, after the president.
The current Vice President of Sierra Leone is Mohamed Juldeh Jalloh.
Mohamed Juldeh Jalloh is a member of the ruling Sierra Leone People's Party.
Mohamed Juldeh Jalloh was sworn in as vice president on April 4, 2018.
Mohamed Juldeh Jalloh's swearing-in followed the victory of him and his presidential running mate in the 2018 Sierra Leone presidential election.
